item.title: The only map you need to see as California's billionaire tax fight heats up
item.description: Mark Cuban warns he'll pull startup investments from California if the proposed billionaire wealth tax passes, calling founders who stay "idiots."

item.title: Alina Fernandez to Newsmax: Socialism is 'First Step to Communism'
item.description: Vladimir Lenin once said that "socialism is only but the first step to communism," Alina Fernández, the daughter of Fidel Castro, told Newsmax on Sunday.
